translation.text: HC - Summit Station ADA Ramp Rehabilitation Project

Beginning Wednesday, September 16, the existing ADA ramp at the Summit Station will be temporarily out of service for rehabilitation and is expected to remain closed for approximately two months.  During this time, passengers using wheelchairs or requiring accessible access must use the existing ramp located at the southwest end of Platform 2 (inbound) to access boarding platforms.
MDW train #2206 scheduled to arrive Chicago Union Station at 7:03 AM, may be operating 15 to 25 minutes behind schedule due to signal problems. Visit metratracker.com for the location of your train.
RI The LaSalle Street Station CTA elevator is temporarily out of service.

The LaSalle Street Station CTA elevator is temporarily out of service. Recommended alternative located at LaSalle St. Station west elevator and East Escalators. Metra will provide updated information once service has been restored

NCS train #101 schedule to depart Chicago Union Station at 7:10 am, will not operate due to a crew shortage from yesterday's police investigation. Train #105 will be the next train to accommodate passengers.
Due to construction, the east end of platform 2 (south platform) at Kedzie will be closed until the end of October. Please use caution near the work area during this time. Updates will be provided.
Metra Electric - On Oct. 24-25, Trains Will Originate/Terminate at 18th St.

On the weekend of Oct. 24-25, Sunday schedules will be in effect on the Metra Electric Line. Metra trains will terminate and originate from the 18th Street Station, with bus service between Millennium Station and 18th Street due to construction work associated with the South Shore Line's expansion plans. ADA passengers with mobility needs must transfer at McCormick Place. Visit Metra.com for more information.

The South Water elevator is closed to all passengers during reconstruction. ADA passengers should use Van Buren Station for elevator access. For the latest service alerts and real-time info visit Metra.com/MEelevators.
NCS Rosemont Elevator Out of Service
The Rosemont elevator is out of service.  Customers can use Schiller Park or O'Hare Transfer as alternate boarding stations.
NCS Train #108 On the Move Delayed
NCS train #108, scheduled to depart Antioch at 6:30 AM, has departed and may be operating 35 to 40 minutes behind schedule due to a crew shortage.
NCS train #100 scheduled to depart Antioch at 5:12 am, will not operate due to crew shortage from yesterday's police investigation. Train #102 will be the next train to accommodate passengers.

The north/south parking lots at the 115th St/Morgan Park station are open to the public and ADA accessibility has been restored. Station construction is expected to continue through Spring 2027. Metra will provide updates once construction is complete.
NCS Train #102 On the Move Delayed
NCS train #102, scheduled to depart Antioch at 6:00 AM, has departed and may be operating 40 to 45 minutes behind schedule due to a crew shortage.

Platform construction will take place at the Morton Grove station beginning Monday, August 3 through Spring 2027. Please allow additional travel time and use caution near the work area during this time. Updates will be provided.

SWS #806 scheduled to depart Manhattan at 6:51 AM, will originate at 179rh street due to PTC issues. Train #808 will accommodate passengers from Manhattan. Visit metratracker.com for the location of your train.

Effective, October 10, Union Pacific North line will be operating extra service before and after the Northwestern Football games at Ryan Field. In addition, passengers attending Northwestern football games will ride free when displaying their game tickets to onboard personnel. Visit metra.com for schedule information.
